messages:
josh (sales): Heads-up: RFP from MedData — attached questionnaire. They require SOC2 + HIPAA, VPC + queryable audit logs, and 7y retention for some PII. Need product answer by Fri EOD. Link: https://redwood.co/meddata-qna

support-bot: Ticket #3421 created: meddata-rfp. Assigned to elaine.

elaine (pm): Adding to backlog triage. @samir can you confirm whether 7y retention is feasible in Private? Also do we have evidence pack for SOC2 + HIPAA we can share?

samir (sec): Short answer: we have SOC2 Type II report and HIPAA BAA template, but 7y retention is above our standard 1y retention. Options: 1) customer-managed archiving (S3 lifecycle) 2) extended retention as paid add-on 3) require legal approval. Need exact data types + scope.

josh (sales): They said retention applies to audit logs + customer PII (user profiles). Timeline: pilot in 6 weeks. They're pushing for included in contract.

elaine (pm): Propose triage plan: collect questionnaire answers, compile evidence pack, estimate eng effort for retention change. If effort > 2wks, suggest sales negotiation (6mo proof + extended retention in Premium).

samir (sec): Checklist I'm starting: SOC2 report, HIPAA controls mapping, dataflow diagram, audit log export example. @compliance-bot please attach current evidence docs.

compliance-bot: Attached: SOC2-2024.pdf, HIPAA-BAA-template.docx, audit-logs-spec.md

elaine (pm): I'll create a backlog card with ACs. Draft ACs: a) documented evidence bundle b) retention config w/ default 1y + opt-in to 7y c) audit log export endpoint d) compliance testing steps. Any additions?

samir (sec): Add: encryption at rest/in-transit confirmation, KMS integration notes, and retention deletion proof (WORM vs delete logs).

josh (sales): :thumbsup: I'll tell customer we can deliver evidence pack + proposed retention options by Fri. If they insist, escalate to contracts.

elaine (pm): Great. I'll attach the backlog card once created. Quick config example for opt-in retention we can show the customer:
```
retention:
  default: 1y
  policy: "archive-to-s3"
  opt_in_long_term: true
  long_term_duration: 7y
```

support-bot: Backlog card created: PROD-8123 "MedData RFP: retention & audit logs" — assignee: elaine, estimate: 5d triage + 8d eng.

josh (sales): Thanks — looping in legal for contract language. @samir any blockers for HIPAA evidence release to customer?

samir (sec): Need to scrub customer-specific test data and remove internal notes; legal sign-off required. Not a blocker for providing standard docs.

elaine (pm): OK. We'll proceed. Closing loop here — will post updates in this thread. :white_check_mark:
